name: entry
notes: PE entry: __security_init_cookie then ___tmainCRTStartup (00)

name: ___tmainCRTStartup
notes: Ghidra VS2005 library match; calls WinMain(0x400000,0,cmdline,nShow) (00)

name: WinMain
notes: cmdline flags, appdata dir, starts supervisor thread, main-thread window/D3D request loop (00)

name: accessibility_keys_disable_or_restore
notes: SPI sticky/toggle/filter keys; arg0=disable, !=0 restore (00)

name: app_supervisor_thread_proc
notes: creates game thread, runs loading loop, ExitProcess on shutdown (00)

name: game_main_thread_proc
notes: game init calls then loop on game_frame_tick (00)

name: game_frame_tick
notes: per-frame update, returns 1 to quit. Hooked live: called repeatedly (frame 3600 reached at ~18 FPS at the main menu) (00)

name: startup_loading_render_loop
notes: inferred: clear/present loop until DAT_02527e94==3 (00)

name: pump_window_messages
notes: PeekMessageW/Translate/Dispatch + IME reset (00)

name: single_instance_check_and_create_window
notes: CreateMutexA, FindWindowA 'Saints Row 2', calls create_game_window (00)

name: create_game_window
notes: sole caller of RegisterClassExA/CreateWindowExA (00)

name: gfx_init_request
notes: inferred: graphics init from WinMain request block -> 0xd1f3f0 -> gfx_d3d9_create (00)

name: gfx_d3d9_create
notes: sole caller of Direct3DCreate9 (00)

name: input_dinput8_create
notes: sole caller of DirectInput8Create (00)

name: game_init_allocators_and_packfiles
notes: first game-thread init; fs_init, mounts 16 boot vpps from 0xe98a28, creates memory pools, signals window/D3D creation (01)

name: fs_init
notes: file system init; calls packfile_system_init (01)

name: packfile_system_init
notes: LTCG EAX=params{max_files,max_pf,pool,max_temp,temp_pool}; allocs global tables (01)

name: packfile_mount
notes: ECX=path -> bool AL; no stack args; permanent mount (01 §5a). Replaced by Rust (hooks.rs), installed early from DllMain thread; 16 boot mounts identical to docs/analysis/golden/boot_mounts.txt

name: packfile_path_valid
notes: ECX=path -> AL; basename into 0x40 buf, strlen<=0x40, so effectively path!=NULL (01 §5a)

name: path_basename
notes: EDI=path, cdecl (dst, size); after last \ or /, strncpy, dst[size-1]=0 (01 §5a)

name: packfile_find_mounted
notes: cdecl(name) -> packfile*; _stricmp vs pf+0x8 over permanent array (01 §5a)

name: file_close
notes: cdecl(file_handle*) (01 §5a)

name: packfile_mount_temp
notes: LTCG ECX=path, EAX=packfile** out, stack file_handle** out, caller-clean, AL; restores ECX (01 §5b). Replaced by Rust; city-load log identical to golden/temp_mounts.txt

name: packfile_load
notes: ESI=slot; stack(handle,permanent,register) caller-clean; reads hdr/dir/names/ext (01)

name: packfile_header_install
notes: validates magic 0x51890ACE and version==4; copies 0x180-byte header (01)

name: packfile_alloc_tables
notes: EDI=packfile; allocs dir/names/ext into +0x170/+0x174/+0x178 (01)

name: file_read_sector_aligned
notes: ECX=size, stack dst; 0x800-sector reads with bounced tail (01)

name: packfile_fixup_and_register
notes: stack(pf,register); string ptr fixup, sector compute, entry+0x18=pf, hash insert (01)

name: packfile_fixup_string_ptrs
notes: EAX=pf; entry name/ext offsets -> pointers (01)

name: packfile_compute_entry_sectors
notes: EAX=pf; only if !(flags&2); entry+8 = start sector (01)

name: hash_filename_ci
notes: EDX=str; h=rotl(h,6)^tolower(c) (01). Replaced by sr2_formats::hash::filename_hash; in-process self-test vs original + main menu verified

name: packfile_hash_insert
notes: cdecl(file_record*); linear probe (01)

name: packfile_find_record
notes: cdecl(name_ext) -> file_record*; last match wins; no wrap, NULL if probe runs off the end (01). Replaced by Rust (hooks.rs), original kept on trampoline; in-game verify over all 53018 records matched

name: packfile_find_entry
notes: ECX=path -> vpp_entry*; basename, priority packfile scan, then find_record (01 §5b). Replaced by Rust, shadow-checked against the original on every call

name: vpp_entry_full_name
notes: ECX=entry, ESI=buf; name.ext (01)

name: file_open
notes: ECX=path; stack (mode, flag) caller-clean -> file_handle* (0x16C, pooled) (01 §5d). Reads replaced by Rust (9843 distinct calls identical); writes/appends still go to the original

name: file_resolve
notes: EAX=location*, stack name, caller-clean, AL; walks search paths [{1,0},{0,0},{1,1}] (01 §5c). Replaced by Rust, shadow-checked on every call (22k calls, 0 mismatches)

name: file_resolve_in_packfile
notes: ESI=location*, stack (name, arg); kind 1 via packfile_find_entry, size = entry+0x10 (01 §5c). Ported inside file_resolve

name: file_resolve_on_disk
notes: EDI=location*, stack (path, arg); arg must be 0; fopen/fseek/_ftelli64; leaks FILE* on seek/size failure (01 §5c). Ported inside file_resolve

name: file_read
notes: EAX=size; stack(dst,handle) -> bytes; dispatch disk/packfile/memory (01)

name: packfile_stream_read
notes: offset = pf+0x150 + entry+0xC; inflate if pf flags&1 (01)

name: os_file_read
notes: ESI=os_file, ECX=dst, EDI=size, stack offset; ReadFile (+OVERLAPPED) (01)

name: os_file_read_inflate
notes: zlib 1.2.1 inflate in 0x8000 chunks (01)

name: os_file_open
notes: cdecl(path,mode,async) -> os_file*; CreateFileA 0x08000080 (01)

name: os_file_seek
notes: SetFilePointer wrapper (01)

name: packfile_find_temp
notes: cdecl(path) -> packfile*; _stricmp of the whole path vs pf+0x8 over the temp array (01 §5b)

name: file_resolve_indexed
notes: ESI=location*, ECX=name, stack arg; kind 2 via 0xC1DA80/0xC20CA0 + _stat; unused on PC (01 §5c)

name: indexed_file_lookup
notes: ECX=name, stack (path_out, 0x100, size_out*); basename -> 0xC20CA0 table (string base 0x252A630) (01 §5c)

name: file_handle_alloc
notes: no args -> file_handle* from pool 0x33D9710 under critical section 0x33DA2D4 (01 §5d)

name: pool_free
notes: ECX=item, stack pool; callee-clean (ret 4); used to free file handles (01 §5d)

name: file_source_open
notes: ECX=location*, EDX=mode, ESI=handle -> AL; kind 1 via 0xC18300, kinds 0/2 via 0xC181C0; stream to +0x14C (01 §5d)
